title: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna wins National Book Award
summary_en: Brenda Hillman, who earned an MFA from the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop in 1976, is the winner of the 2026 National Book Award for Poetry.
title_cn: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna wins National Book Award

title: UI aerospace research, flight-testing lab opens second location at Eastern Iowa Airport
summary_en: The UI’s Operator Performance Laboratory has opened a second location at the Eastern Iowa Airport in Cedar Rapids to expand its aerospace research and flight-testing capabilities while bringing university researchers, students, and industry partners closer together. The new space also will create experiential learning opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students.
title_cn: UI aerospace research, flight-testing lab opens second location at Eastern Iowa Airport

title: Big ideas in research, creative discovery taking shape at Iowa
summary_en: The UI is building momentum and helping researchers, artists, and students bring new ideas to life through efforts guided by its 2022–2027 Strategic Plan. From supporting NASA space studies to expanding opportunities for cancer research and the arts, Iowa is investing in the people and facilities needed to advance scientific discoveries and creative work.
title_cn: Big ideas in research, creative discovery taking shape at Iowa

title: Iowa's first women's wrestling recruit makes history on the world stage
summary_en: As the first recruit of the Iowa women’s wrestling team, Kylie Welker has helped build the program into a national powerhouse while becoming the first American wrestler to win three consecutive U23 world titles. With the first home meet of her final season approaching, lessons from Iowa's coaches and classrooms are preparing her to pursue Olympic gold and a future in coaching.
title_cn: Iowa's first women's wrestling recruit makes history on the world stage
